batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b AB Dinda

batting.name: UBT Chand
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b R Sharma

batting.name: BJ Rohrer
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b AM Nayar

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b AB Dinda

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b IK Pathan

batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b IK Pathan

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c BJ Rohrer b UT Yadav

batting.name: LJ Wright
batting.dismissal: c DA Warner b UT Yadav

balls.text: Pathan has thrashed this short ball through midwicket for four. He is on the front foot, but he goes ahead with the shot, and connects well
well bowled. Yorker on off, dug out to point, Warner doesn't turn down the single
gets the length ball that he wants, but this one goes off the inside half of the bat, and he is caught at long-on
that's clean out of the crews. Jadhav picks the short ball early, goes back and across, and smacks this clean over midwicket for a six
down the leg side, but not called a wide

Skier. Yuvraj makes a superb effort, but can't get to it. This is a shortish delivery, Jadhav goes after it, gets too much under it, Yuvraj runs from midwicket towards long-on, but can't reach it despite the dive

Warner hits the third six of the over. It's the dreaded length ball again. Warner clears the front leg again, and hits this over wide long-on. This has cleared the rope, but the boundaries in Raipur are huge
down the wicket, Richardson follows him, induces a leading edge, the ball has hardly cleared point, but Warner hares back for two
Warner backs away, advances a little, turns this into a half-volley, clears the front leg ad lofts this back over Richardson's head. Into the sightscreen
good yorker, on the pads, gets a dot through
wide and full, driven to long-on for one
length ball. Not what you bowl at death. Jadhav has advanced down the wicket and lofted this back over the bowler's head. Clean hit
Warner has an almighty heave-ho at this, and is beaten by the extra bounce. This is not the easiest of pitches to bat on
full and wide, dug out to point
Jadhav gives him the charge, BK slips in the bouncer, but it has been called wide for height. Twelve wides so far
slower shortish ball, Warner has to check his cut, gets a single to cover
this would have been a wide had Jadhav not toe-ended it for a single to point
full toss outside off, driven wide of long-off for a couple
starts off with a slower ball, Jadhav doesn't do much with it
short, regulation pace, the angle gives him the width, and Warner has crashed this wide of long-off for four
slower ball, short of a length, middle and leg, defended back to him
slower ball, short of a length, skids through after pitching, gets the dot it as Warner is beaten on the pull
low full toss this time, and Warner has driven this to the other side of long-off, to his left. Smith charges around from long-on, dives, gets a hand to it, but can't keep it in
not quite the yorker, Warner can get under it, and he scoops it wide of long-off for four
short of a length, on off, worked to leg for one
full, middle and off, pushed to midwicket for one
looks to cut this, beaten because this is bot short enough
full, on off, dug out for a single to long-off
pulled away. He has picked the length early, gone back early, and has pulled this between long leg and deep midwicket. Not too high, but it has gone in the gap
short, outside off, rising towards the chest, dabbed away to third man
short of a length, on the pads, gets away with just a leg-bye
short, and he gets away with it. Warner has pulled this straight to deep midwicket
slightly short, he rocks back to pull, gets a single to deep midwicket
a friendly gentle full toss wasted by a sweep across the line
looks to cut, but this is not short or flat enough. Finds point
stops a bit at it, hit uppishly towards the non-striker, beats Yuvraj's dive
down the wicket to bunt this into the leg side for one
length ball, into the pads, worked away to long leg for one

that's a good catch, that's a good good catch. This is a healthy edge, and Uthappa has done really well to hold on standing up to the stumps. Rohrer drives at this angling across him, gets a thick edge and an appreciable deflection, but Uthappa has taken this really well
punched away from off, will get just the single to deep cover
length ball, on the pads, this time they will get just a single to long leg
worked away off the pads, they take on Bhuvneshwar's arm, and Rohrer completes the second with a dive
short of a length, just outside off, defended off the back foot
googly, dabs on it, but can't beat point
Warner has cleared this. These boundaries are not small, so this needed a big hit. He clears the front leg and slogs this from outside off, and straight back over his head
short, flat, Warner pulls it away off the pads for four through square leg
full and flat, pushed to long-on for one
tossed up, middle and leg, pushed to long-on, they want the second, but won't get it
driven powerfully, but straight to cover
gets a bottom edge on the attempted cut, gets a couple to fine leg
on a length, on off, defended to cover
short of a length, on the pads, these are easy runs as Nayar has not got his radar right. Guided away easily
short of a length, on off, defended to cover
pulled away wide of long leg, comes back for the second
short, wide down the leg side
pulled away for a single to deep midwicket
this is the googly, beats the outside edge, hits the pad in front, but is missing off
tossed up, driven to long-off
friendly full toss, pushed to long-on for one
flighted outside off, defended to short cover
extra bounce for Rahul Sharma. Chand wants to cut this shortish delivery, but the extra bounce takes the edge, and Uthappa takes the catch
stays back to defend a shortish delivery
he has gloved it. Dinda has done Sehwag in with the bouncers. This is not the best of the lot as this is headed down leg, Sehwag tries the pull, but has gloved it through to the keeper
bouncer, on the stumps, Sehwag thinks of the ramp, but pulls out
backs away, slashes, is beaten
dug in short, gets big on him, hits the high part of the bat, but falls safe short of cover
punched to deep cover for a single
short of a length, straight, defended to the right of Dinda
makes room, but Yuvraj pitches up on leg, defended back to him
guided to short fine leg for a single
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, still manages to place it wide of point
pushed wide of cover-point for a single
low full toss, hit uppishly towards long-off for one
driven to long-off
slower ball, angling too far down leg, and Sehwag helps it along
length ball, hits the high part of the bat, goes for a single towards long-on
wide down the leg side. Nine of them now
short of a length, steered away to third man for one
tucked away off the hip for a single
driven on the up, gets a single to deep cover
he has mit-hit this pull, but the fine leg is in the circle, and he is safe
wide down the leg side to begin with
short of a length, worked into the leg side, Sehwag initiates the second, and gets it
driven to long-on for one
full, middle and leg, pushed to deep midwicket for one
paddled away. Premeditated, but executed well
makes room to chip this to long-off for one
on a length, middle and leg, defended back to him
short of a length, moves across to defend
this one straightens after pitching short and outside off, beats the punch
short of a length, angling in, hits the pad, goes for a leg-bye
short of a length, cramps Sehwag who is backing away. Defended back to him
wide down the leg side
short of a length, angling in, Sehwag arches back, cuts hard at it, fine of third man, gets four more
bouncer, on the stumps, too high. Called wide
Sehwag is away. That's typical Sehwag. Length ball, on off, he clears the front leg, and lofts this into the sight screen
outswinger, Chand throws his bat at it more in hope than in conviction, gets a thick edge over point for four
bouncer, Chand charges at it, and is beaten by the extra bounce
short of a length, wide, pushed to point
short of a length, outside off, looks to cut, is beaten by the away movement
angling in, defended off the back foot

Wright catches the ball, Jayawardene catches the bat. The batsmen have been tied up, and the moment they see a full ball, Jayawardene goes after it. Except the ball doesn't quite come on, and he is driving in front of his body. Finch takes it at short cover. Jayawardene throws his bat in the air in exasperation, and catches it too
dug in short, Sehwag leans back to try to ramp it over the cordon. Is beaten
steered away to third man for one
short of a length, outside off, punched away to third man for one
full now, on off, Sehwag has to be watchful in defence
bouncer, outside off, called wide for height
more seam into the pads, beats the inside edge, but is headed down leg, and hence no appeal
nearly chopped on. This one seams appreciably back in, cramping Sehwag up, who is shaping up for the cut. Luckily for him, the bottom edge doesn't meet the stumps
pitched up full and wide, Jayawardene drives at it, and is beaten by the straightening of it
fuller, just outside off, solidly defended off the front foot
short of a length, outside off, holds its line, left alone by MJ
swinging too far down the leg side, beats the bat, but has been given wides. I thought it hit the pad on the way. replays show it didn't
wide length ball, Jayawardene moves across to try to drive, gets a bottom edge into the pitch, but it travels to the left of the keeper
swinging in towards off, defended off the back foot by Jayawardene
short of a length, just outside off, defended off the back foot
length ball, angling in towards off, defended off the back foot
steered away to third man. He has had to rise with the bounce to keep this down
short of a length, wide, Mahela lets it be
extra bounce. Dug in short, nips back in, rises towards the chest, just about kisses Mahela's glove on the way
short of a length, widish, left alone
his first ball is ordinary, full and wide outside off, Jayawardene slashes and gets a thick ends that sends it flying over the cordon
movement from a length into the right-hander, Mahela waits in his crease and steers towards third man
defended from the crease towards cover
good length around off stump, Jayawardene gets behind the line and blocks
Sehwag sits back in his crease and square drives, gets a thick outside edge towards third man
short of a length outside off, Sehwag goes back and begins to poke before pulling his bat out of the way
pitches on a good length and seams into Jayawardene, who moves forward and across to work the ball towards long leg
this makes it official. Manhas chips one to deep midwicket. Delhi have won by 15 runs
quick yorker, hit back to him
nearly the yorker, Smith can't get under it. Only the single to deep cover. Delhi have won now
that's one of the four sixes needed. Nadeem bowls length for the first time, and he has launched this over wide long-on. Not sure Smith will get this length again
this time he stands his ground but is yorked again. However, this one he has squeezed past short third for four
Smith charges at him to york himself up. Dug out back to him
moves too far across, looking to pull it behind square, misses a straight, short-of-a-length delivery
Smith is charging, gets a high full toss, gets only a single to long-off
Delhi bowler to Delhi batsman. Manhas is backing away, Nehra follows him, concedes just the single
looks to swipe this, gets a single off the inside edge
slower ball, beats the almighty slow from Smith
Smith might have other idea. Plays the pick-up to a length ball on the pads, clears short fine leg with ease

superb bowling from Yadav. This is the sharper bouncer. Between the shoulder and the head. Yuvraj is going nowhere with the pull, and the top edge is taken at deep square. This has been a lovely over from Yadav
slower short ball, beats the pull

sensational work from Warner, not so from Yuvraj. He has pulled this superbly wide of long-on, Yuvraj is jogging he has got four, but Warner hares across the outfield to put in the dive and keep it in
what a superb over so far from Yadav. He has pushed Wright out of his comfort zone with those two quick deliveries, and now slips in the slower ball, which he has lobbed to long-off
lovely bowling. The perfect yorker on middle and off, dug out back to him
well bowled. Spots him backing away, and he goes full and wide to eke out a dot
this time Yuvraj pulls, and he has managed to get it wide of deep midwicket for a couple
short of a lenght, hip high, no room, Yuvraj can't do much with it
steered away to third man for one
short of a length, down the leg side, goes off the thigh pad for a single
pulled away down the ground again. One bounce to long-off
short, chest high, he backs away and pulls. Not the best of connections, but he has flat-batted it over the bowler's head for four. Mid-off and mid-on were up
cut away, but not past point
Wright looks to pull, gets a top edge to third man for a single
short, wide, cut away to deep cover for one
good bouncer... oh it is a wide. This one gets big on him, Yuvraj pulls out of the pull, but too high
backs away, charges at him, pulls this to long-on for one
lucky for Wright. he backs away and slogs, gets a bottom edge to the left of the keeper for four
dabbed away to third man for a single
backs away, gets a short ball, and smashes it over midwicket for four. Pune needed this to stay in touch
short of a length, wide, it's a good ball because Wright has backed away, and can't quite reach this
driven down the ground, but straight to mid-off
Yadav's pace nearly gets Yuvraj. This is a good short ball, sharp, quick, gets the top edge on the short-arm pull, but it doesn't quite carry to Nehra in the deep
slower ball, dabbed away to the right of point. They get a single
and he starts with a good bouncer, which Wright gets under
short of a length, stump to stump, Yuvraj plays this over out defensively. Those four runs off the glove are a bonus
short of a length, just outside off, defended back to him
short of a length, into the ribs, Yuvraj is hit on the glove, but it goes fine, fine of fine leg for four
on a length, on the pads, clipped away to fine leg
short of a length, on the pads, worked away fine of fine leg
short of a length, on off, punched away to point
driven to deep cover. Still doesn't look happy
short of a length, wide, punched away past point for four. Through Warner. That's surprising
short of a length, on the pads, worked away for a single
full, on off, driven to long-off for one
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
on a length, wide, crunched away on the up, past deep cover for four. That fielder doesn't have much to move, but this has been timed superbly
tossed up outside off, pushed wide of cover for a single. Warner, the fielder, seems to be limping
fired in down the leg side. Yuvraj gets some bat on it, past the keeper
short, outside off, pulled away for a single
dabbed away to point
cut away in the air, but falls short of Pathan at point
slogs at the first ball, gets a single off the mis-hit, to deep midwicket

Pathan has got a strangle down the leg side, but I am pretty sure it came off the thigh pad. And I haven;t yet seen a replay. It has come off his pocket, shows the replay. Poor umpiring in IPL continues. Short of a lenght, down the leg side, Finch is beaten, Jadhav catches this off the trouser, but the prolonged appeal has given them the wicket
whipped away off the pads, between fine leg and deep square leg for a couple
cut away, but can't beat point
short of a length, swinging back towards off, defended back to him
length ball, outside leg, Uthappa clips it, but hits it too sweetly, and it carries into the long leg region. Chand has taken a good catch running to his left from fine leg
makes room to cut this away towards third man for one
this time played to the other side of deep midwicket, and this time they get the second
pulled away this time, to the left of deep midwicket, and such is the reputation of Warner they are not thinking of the second, which they would have got because Warner has fumbled
short of a length, quick, no room, defended back to him
short, no room, cut away straight to point
slow through the air, Finch looks to guide it square, but finds point
swept away from the line of off, gets a single to deep backward square
pushed down the ground for a single
slower ball, short of a length, breaking in, worked away for a single
short of a length, angling in, pushed to midwicket
short, wide, cut away, wide of deep point, gets a couple
short of a length, down the leg side, called a wide
slower ball, has completely done Uthappa in, but the lob falls well short of long-on
length ball, quick, hits the high part of the bat
swept away, but can't beat short fine leg
short of a length, outside off, punched wide of cover for one
punched to deep cover for one
arm ball, too short, flat, and he has back-cut this past point for four
some turn for Nadeem. Defended to cover-point
short, wide, cut away to deep cover for one
worked into the open spaces on the leg side for a couple. Pathan bowls a maiden, is taken off, then comes back and 15 come off his over
chipped away high in the air, wide of long-on, straight of deep midwicket. Well placed
short of a length, no room, defended back

dabbed away to point, Uthappa wants one, is sent back. Rohrer tries to run Uthappa, who changes direction while going back. The ball goes for four overthrows, Uthappa apologises, which could suggest it has deflected off the bat. Shouldn't Delhi be appealing for obstructing the field if that is the case?
plants the front foot down, paddles this length ball from outside off, fine of fine leg for four
a hint of swing still, worked away off the pads for the first run off Pathan's bowling tonight
length ball, outside off, pushed wide of mid-on for one
short of a lenght, hits the pad, but it is pitched outside leg
short of a length, on the pads, worked away for a single to short fine leg
on a length, on off, defended to cover-point
short of a length, outside off, pushed to cover-point. Not only do they steal one, a wayward throw allows them the overthrow too
on the pads, gets away with just the leg-bye
clipped away off the pads again. Over midwicket this time. A very good first half has been followed by a poor second half this over
big wide down the leg side

nicely played. Rides the bounce on this one, opens the face late, guides it past slip. Yadav is fine at third man, puts a dive in, and a straighter throw would have dismissed Uthappa who is coming back for the second
too full, too straight, clipped away off the pads, over square leg for four
defended off the front foot, there won't be any single as cover is alert
again a Morkel delivery gets big on the batsman. Uthappa is beaten outside off
Finch gets a leading edge that lands short of mid-off and straight of cover, and he has gone for a suicidal run. Mahela misses by inches. Finch had given up
ruins a good over with a poor last ball. On a length, on the pads, with fine leg in, and he has helped it away for four
short of a length, outside off, pushed to cover-point
on a length, on off, pushed to mid-off for one
moves across to push a lenght ball into the leg side for one
backs away to make room, cuts this away from outside leg, gets a single to third man
appeal for lbw right away, but this has taken the inside edge on the way. There is shape back in to encourage the appeal
short of a length, on off, defended towards cover
short of a length, rising, outside off, he has risen with the bounce, and has guided this wide of slip. Deliberate shot
short of a length, moving in, he moves across to get inside its line, and guides it past square leg for a couple
seaming back in, hits the inside half of the bat, concedes a single to leg
moves across to work this wide of midwicket for a single
Uthappa moves too far across, is beaten, but this might just be missing leg
full, big drive from Finch, the inside edge onto the pad saves him
big and quick seam movement back in, catches him on the pad, but it is headed down leg

short of a length, into the pads, nicely worked away past midwicket. A misfield there converts two into three. Nadeem does well with the chase, but there is nobody following him to partake in the relay throw
uppish, but in the gap. Finch ends up playing in front of the body as this stops on him a bit, but this has gone between short cover and cover
too full, too straight, clipped away through midwicket for four
short of a length, shaping away, beats the punch
full, outside off, driven to mid-off. Pathan begins with a maiden yet again
short of a length, shaping back in, defended back to him
slight shape back in, defended to midwicket
short of a length, just outside off, Uthappa walks down the wicket to defend
short of a length, angling away, patted to point
